summary_md:
# Investor køber AI-aktie: “Nu sker der noget”

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-09-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Danish episode centres on Meta, which guest Nina Movin bought for the Børsen Allstar portfolio. Her case is the launch of the Muse AI agent, Meta's billions of users, its grip on advertising and a P/E she puts around the high 20s. The panel also covers risks to the AI boom: Oracle declaring force majeure on a New Mexico data centre amid local opposition, cheaper Chinese AI models pushing down prices, and doubts about whether $10T of AI infrastructure spending can earn a return. Other segments are Better Collective's 34% crash on a Brazilian betting ban, Simon's top 3 Danish stock collapses (Novo, Bavarian Nordic, Pandora) and portfolio trades: Microsoft and Infineon out, Meta and AMD in, Demant sold to add to Novo Nordisk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 META — Meta | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest Nina bought Meta for Allstar after the Muse launch; buy-and-hold, no plans to sell.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: Muse shows the AI spend turning into products. Meta has ~3.6bn daily users, an iron grip on business advertising and its own data centres; revenue grew 28%. P/E in the 20s is not expensive. The market underrates its earnings. JP Morgan (cited) is more positive. Risks: heavy capex (~$130-145bn), debt, negative FCF, lawsuits and EU regulation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a scandal or lawsuit arises that cannot be defended
- if AI capex fails to deliver returns, as with the metaverse
- if the debt burden becomes unmanageable

> *"Men ellers vil jeg sige, det er køb og behold, medmindre der kommer en eller anden sag, hvor man tænker, det kan man altså ikke stå inden for."*

---

### 🟢 AMD — AMD | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nina bought AMD for Allstar, replacing Infineon; 'baby Nvidia' with cheaper data centre systems.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: cheaper data centre chip systems, exciting product pipeline and a new 3D/physical acquisition. Explicitly risky: the stock has risen a lot and would fall if the AI theme tilts.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI theme tilts
- if data centre demand weakens

> *"Så hvis AI-temaet tilter, så tilter alt det her. Så den er risikofyldt."*

---

### 🔴 MSFT — Microsoft | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Sold from Allstar after it passed $500 and paused; still called a great stock.

#### Reasoning

Guest Nina took profits after a strong run from June to rebuild the portfolio. Momentum stalled after $500, so this is a rotation, not a negative view of the company.

> *"Men den var gået igennem 500, og der begyndte den at tage en lille pause."*

---

### 🔴 IFX — Infineon | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Sold from Allstar at a 20%+ loss and replaced by AMD.

#### Reasoning

Did not perform as hoped; Nina cut the loss and rotated into AMD.

> *"den endte vi med at tabe nogen og 20% på den aktie"*

---

### 🟢 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars Hytting added at 254; now 16.5% of Allstar and the largest position.

#### Reasoning

Allstar participant added to Novo after selling Demant, a heavy bet that the stock must rise. Simon earlier argued the CagriSema sell-off was an overreaction to good data. The stock trades around 250.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further trial disappointments occur
- if obesity market share keeps eroding

> *"Men vi har nu 16,5 procent på porteføljen i Novo Nordisk, og man må nok sige, at det er en rimelig tung bet."*

---

### 🔴 DEMANT — Demant | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars Hytting sold Demant after a strong year (+DKK 22k on 50k) to fund Novo.

#### Reasoning

Profit-taking rotation, not a negative view; the stock performed very well this year.

> *"Demand-aktien var rigtig, rigtig god. Den har kørt super, super godt i år"*

---

### 🟢 GN — GN Store Nord | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Hytting holds GN long-term and added a little as it lifted slightly.

#### Reasoning

Small addition to a long-held position on early signs of a recovery.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the recovery fails

> *"Den er faktisk lettet en lille bitte smule, så måske at det rent faktisk er nu"*

---

### 🟡 BIOG-B — BioGaia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Peter is most confident in BioGaia; strong last quarter, broker upgrades, expects a good Q3.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter: the stock fell after the quarterly report without news despite excellent results; brokers have upgraded and it is rising from the bottom. He expects a good Q3.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 disappoints

> *"Det er faktisk den, jeg er mest sikker på, at de tre vil være okay."*

---

### 🟡 COLO-B — Coloplast | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Peter holds it in Allstar but is more uncertain.

#### Reasoning

Held with less conviction than BioGaia; no new developments.

---

### 🟡 CHEMM — ChemoMetec | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Peter holds it; the business is fine but he is uncertain about valuation; the stock is volatile.

#### Reasoning

The concern is valuation, not business quality; high volatility.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation stays stretched

---

### ⛔ ORCL — Oracle | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Force majeure on a New Mexico data centre, debt near junk, already challenged.

#### Reasoning

Guest Nina: local opposition and missing permits delay the project; Oracle is highly leveraged with debt near junk; the credit market reacted strongly.

> *"deres gæld ligger på kanten til at blive junk, fordi de er meget forgældede"*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Power cables needed for the data centre build-out; called exciting.

#### Reasoning

Power demand from AI data centres supports demand for high-voltage cables.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the data centre build-out stalls

> *"Ja, det er jo spændende aktie. Det er sådan noget, der er brug for."*

---

### 🟠 BETCO — Better Collective | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell 34% on a Brazilian betting ban; some see a buying chance as the ban is temporary.

#### Reasoning

An important market is shut, guidance was cut and suspended, and buybacks paused. The temporary ban may make it a contrarian opportunity, but the host is cautious.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Brazilian ban becomes permanent

> *"Der vil selvfølgelig også tale med nogen, de ser det som en mulig købstilbud, eller købsmulighed, fordi det indtil videre kun er et midlertidigt forbud."*

---
